content: Promoting positive health behaviors and psychological well-being is essential for individuals with diabetes to achieve their management goals and enhance their overall quality of life. Key components in this process include diabetes self-management education and support (DSMES), medical nutrition therapy (MNT), regular physical activity, and psychosocial care. After conducting a comprehensive health evaluation, healthcare professionals are advised to adopt a person-centered approach. This involves actively supporting patients in making informed decisions, setting realistic behavioral goals, and monitoring their psychological and physical well-being.
